text: Make sure to check for cracked glass.. I really like it, although,the bottom of the vase has a good size crack in the glass. I was going to give it as a gift, returning it isn't worth my time or the fact I could cut myself. Seller offered a replacement for the return of the cracked vase. I don't want to take any chances, so I'm going to keep it and look for another gift for my friend.
